title: Production of Clone-like Chicken by Primordial Germ Cells Induced From Somatic Cells
protocol: Inoculate well-grown CEF of Black Feather Langshan Chicken in a 24-well plate at a density of 1.5×10^5 cells per well.
Culture CEF in DMEM containing 10% FBS until cell density reaches about 60%.
Add 300 μL of virus diluted in serum-free DMEM medium to each well, including four mixed lentiviral vectors at a ratio of 1:1:1:1 under a multiplicity of infection of 10 and 5 ng/mL polybrene.
Dilute the virus by adding serum-free DMEM containing 5 ng/mL polybrene after 6 hours of transfection.
Replace culture medium with DMEM containing 10% FBS at 24 hours post-transfection.
Detect expression of enhanced green fluorescence protein at 72 hours post-transfection.
Collect well-grown CEF and pass them to the second generation in a 60 mm diameter petri dish.
Treat CEF with culture medium containing 10 μg/mL mitomycin C for 2.5 hours at 37℃, 5% CO2 conditions.
Remove the mitomycin C-containing medium after treatment.
Wash the CEF eight times with PBS.
Digest the CEF using 1 mL of 0.25% trypsin for 3 minutes.
Add 2 mL of DMEM containing 10% FBS to stop the digestion process.
Inoculate cells with 2×10^5 cells/well in a 24-well plate and culture.
Culture transfected fibroblasts in 10% FBS medium for 72 hours, then replace the medium with iPSCs induction medium.
Transfer cells onto CEF feeder layer treated with mitomycin on the 5th day of induction when morphology changes significantly.
Change half of the DMEM medium daily according to cell status.
Pick up single-cell clone colony under a stereo fluorescence microscope and inoculate into 96 well dishes with feeder cells after accutase digestion.
Subculture CEF from 48-well dish to 24-well dish once feeder layer cells fall off, using the same method.
Collect culture supernatant of iPS cells and gently wash bottom of 24-well dish with PBS to remove superfluous serum.
Add 200 μL of accutase digestion solution to 24-well dish and digest at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge collected digested cells and supernatant at 1000 g for 8 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of accutase digestive juice to cell precipitation.
Digest iPS clone at 37 ℃ for 10 minutes, shaking every 3 minutes.
Dilute the accutase digestive juice by adding more than three times its volume with factor medium.
Filter diluted accutase digestive juice with a 400 mesh filter cloth.
Inoculate filtered mixture onto new feeding layer.
Replace the medium after iPS cells adhere to the new feeder layer for 6 hours.
Wash cells induced for 21 days twice with 200 μL PBS.
Fix cells with 200 μL 4% paraformaldehyde for 30 minutes.
Wash fixed cells three times with 200 μL PBS.
Treat cells with 200 μL 1% Triton for 20 minutes.
Wash treated cells three times with 200 μL PBS.
Block cells with 200 μL antibody blocking solution for 2 hours.
Incubate cells with 200 μL primary antibody at 37°C for 2 hours and overnight at 4°C.
Wash cells with 200 μL PBS-T three times, each time for 5 minutes.
Incubate cells with 200 μL secondary antibody for 2 hours at 37°C in the dark.
Wash cells with 200 μL PBS-T three times, five minutes each time.
Stain with 5 ng/μL DAPI for ten minutes.
Use fluorescence inverted microscope to observe results.
Remove supernatant from cultured cells and wash with PBS.
Add ALP fixative to fix cells for three minutes and then wash with PBS.
Add ALP incubation solution, protect from light for fifteen to twenty minutes, and wash with PBS.
Add nuclear fast red staining or methyl green staining solution for counterstaining for three to five minutes.
Wash cells with PBS and examine under microscope.
Inoculate 5×10^6 iPS in a 100mm culture dish.
Culture cells until the logarithmic growth stage, then add colchicine at final concentration of 0.1 mol/L.
After four hours of culture, discard medium, add 2 ml 0.25% trypsin, and incubate for three minutes.
Add DMEM with 10% FBS to terminate digestion and centrifuge at 1000g for eight minutes.
Incubate cells in 5 ml 40 mmol/L KCl; re-form cells by hypoexuding with 25 mmol/L sodium citrate and stand at 37°C for twenty minutes.
Add cold methanol acetate fixative solution prepared by equal volume fresh to precipitate suspended cells.
Suspend the cells.
Allow the suspension to stand for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the suspension at 1000g for 10 minutes.
Discard the fixed solution.
Add 0.2mL methanol acetate solution to re-form the suspended cell mass.
Pipette a drop of cell suspension and release it from about 30 cm onto an ice-cooled slide.
Tilt the slide to allow droplets to flow down and spread out.
Place the slides in the oven to dry.
Observe and adjust the cell density through a phase contrast microscope until no cell overlap is visible.
Place the prepared slides in the tissue box for Giemsa staining.
Add Giemsa working fluid to completely cover the slides and stain for 5 minutes.
Wash away the dye solution slowly with running water.
Dry the glass slides and observe under a microscope.
Inoculate cells in a 100mm petri dish for differential adherent culture for 45 minutes.
Collect supernatant after differential adherent culture.
Remove feeder layer cells from iPS cells by inoculating them into the pore plate with 5×10^4/well density.
Add 40ng/mL BMP4, 40ng/mL BMP8b, and 50ng/mL EGF to the medium containing inducible medium components as base factors for iPS or ESCs cells.
Change half of the induction medium every 12 hours.
Fix cells in a 24-well plate with PAS fixed solution for 10-15 minutes.
Wash cells twice with PBS and air dry.
Add oxidants to cells, oxidize for 15-20 minutes at room temperature, then wash twice with PBS.
Add Schiff reagent into cells, soak in the dark for 10-20 minutes.
Rinse cells with sulfite solution 200 L twice, each rinse lasting 2 minutes.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Redye cells with hematoxylin for 1-2 minutes, then wash twice with PBS.
Incubate fertilized eggs in a humidified incubator at 38 ℃ until Day 2.5.
Clean the broader edge of the eggshell with alcohol cotton balls.
Create a small window by forceps at the broader edge of the eggshell to expose the embryo vessel.
Inject 1 μL cell suspension (5000 cells/μL) into the embryo vessel using a microinjection needle.
Drop 20 μL of penicillin-streptomycin solution onto the embryo.
Seal the small window with plastic tape and return the egg to the incubator for hatching.
Put the sample on the frozen section holder and add embedding agent to spread evenly, ensuring the sample holder remains flat.
Quickly place the sample into liquid nitrogen and freeze-fix it for about 20 seconds until no bubbles are generated.
Place the frozen-fixed sample into the frozen microtome to equilibrate the temperature.
Install the blade in the frozen microtome and trim it with a thickness of 20 μm.
After cutting to the sample, slice it with a thickness of 8 μm, attach each section to a glass slide, and observe under a microscope.
Incubate White Plymouth Rock Chicken embryos injected with PGCs of Black Feather Langshan Chicken until they exude the shell (F0 generation).
Raise F0 generation to sexual maturity.
Mate male and female hens from the F0 generation.
Collect eggs (F1 generation) laid by mated pairs and hatch them.
Observe and record phenotypic traits such as feather color and tibial color in the F1 generation chicken when it is out of its shell.
Collect blood from the wing vein of F1 chickens at the age of 1 month.
Extract the genome from the collected blood for genome sequencing or microsatellite detection.
